faces.name: Mysteries of the Deep
faces.oracleText:
Draw two cards.
Landfall — If you had a land enter the battlefield under your control this turn, draw three cards instead.

faces.name: Mysterio, Master of Illusion
faces.oracleText: When Mysterio enters, create a 3/3 blue Illusion Villain creature token for each nontoken Villain you control. Exile those tokens when Mysterio leaves the battlefield.

faces.name: Mysterio's Mirage
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you discarded a card this turn, create a 3/3 blue Illusion Villain creature token.

faces.name: Mysterio's Phantasm
faces.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance
Whenever this creature attacks, mill a card. (Put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)

faces.name: Mysterious Confluence
faces.oracleText: Choose a card at random from among Righteous Confluence, Mystic Confluence, Wretched Confluence, Fiery Confluence, Verdant Confluence, Brokers Confluence, Cabaretti Confluence, Maestros Confluence, Obscura Confluence, and Riveteers Confluence. Create a copy of that card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. (Roll a D10 to determine the random card.)

faces.name: Mysterious Egg
faces.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

faces.name: Mysterious Hero
faces.oracleText:
Super Secret Identity {2}{U} (Before the game begins, if your deck is sleeved, you may put another creature card on top of this one in the sleeve. Don't tell anyone! If this permanent is on the battlefield, you may pay {2}{U} to remove the card above it in the sleeve.)
Hexproof
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.

faces.name: Mysterious Limousine
faces.oracleText:
Whenever this Vehicle enters or attacks, exile up to one other target creature until this Vehicle leaves the battlefield. If a creature is put into exile this way, return each other card exiled with this Vehicle to the battlefield under its owner's control.
Crew 2
